artifacts.name: SCR-SH-01 Login
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Lets an active employee sign in to PMS with Employee Id and password, and routes first-time users to set their own password. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-SH-02 Set password
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Lets a user replace a temporary password with their own (first login or after an Admin reset), or change their password at any time. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-SH-03 Dashboard (my tasks and status)
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Shows each user, right after login, what needs their action and where they stand, so nothing is missed. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-SH-04 Approvals inbox (all modules)
artifacts.summary: Roles: Manager, Admin. One place for a manager's daily approval routine, so they can clear all pending items across modules quickly (D-24 / UXQ-03). Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-EIMS-01 Employee directory
artifacts.summary: Roles: Manager (team), Admin (all). Lets Admin find and manage any employee, and lets a manager see who is in their team. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-EIMS-02 Employee admin form (create / edit / deactivate)
artifacts.summary: Roles: Admin. Lets Admin onboard a new employee with the minimum details needed to sign in, and later maintain the Admin-owned details (manager, role, wage rate, active status). Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-EIMS-03 My profile
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Lets employees complete and maintain their own personal details and submit them for their manager's approval. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-EIMS-04 Profile review
artifacts.summary: Roles: Manager, Admin. Lets the approver check a submitted profile and approve or reject it, seeing exactly what changed for an update. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-AMS-01 My attendance
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Gives employees a month-at-a-glance view of their attendance, what is approved, what needs action, and which weekdays are missing. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-AMS-02 Attendance entry
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Lets an employee record one day's working times and submit them for approval, or fix a rejected entry. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-AMS-03 Team attendance review
artifacts.summary: Roles: Manager. Lets a manager approve or reject direct reports' attendance, review history, and reopen an approved day when its salary is disputed. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-LMS-01 My leave
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Shows employees all their leave requests and their status, and lets them cancel a pending request or fix a rejected one. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-LMS-02 Leave request
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Lets an employee request full-day leave for a date range, or correct a rejected request, and submit it to their manager. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-LMS-03 Team leave review
artifacts.summary: Roles: Manager. Lets a manager approve or reject direct reports' leave, seeing who else in the team is away on those dates. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-SMS-01 My salary
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Shows employees their daily wages for a period, and lets them accept or dispute each record once their manager has approved it. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-SMS-02 Team salary review
artifacts.summary: Roles: Manager. Lets a manager approve the team's generated wages and resolve disputes, with team totals for the period. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).
artifacts.author: Rajesh Verma

artifacts.name: SCR-SH-00 Shell layout (header, menu, user menu)
artifacts.summary: Roles: All. Gives every PMS screen one consistent frame: header, role-based menu and user menu, so users always know where they are and what they can do. Updated to v1.1 (D-105).

findings.summary: What happens to a deactivated employee's pending items (own submissions and items awaiting their approval as manager)? Closed (D-104): items waiting for a decision stay with the approver and can be decided; other open items of a deactivated employee stay as they are (BR-CMN-06).
Missing attendance reminder (FR-CMN-004): include today, or only days up to yesterday? Closed (D-104): missing days only up to yesterday; today is never missing (FR-CMN-004).

When the Admin changes an employee's manager (BR-CMN-13), who decides items already awaiting approval – old or new manager? Closed (D-104): waiting items move to the new manager (FR-EIMS-017, FR-UM-014).

How does the Admin hand the temporary password to the employee? PMS shows it only once. Closed (D-104): the Administrator sends the temporary password by company email outside PMS; replaced at the first sign-in.
At go-live, are employees onboarded one by one or is a bulk import needed (not in the approved UX)? Closed (D-104): employees onboarded one by one; bulk import Phase 2.
May more than one employee have no manager (top-level)? Raised by the consistency check (D-103). Closed (D-104): exactly one top-level employee (BR-CMN-01, FR-EIMS-014, VR-EIMS-05).
